metadata.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
metadata.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
metadata.keywords: lakh, pradhan, mantri, awas, yojana, pmay, housing, urban, poor, providing
metadata.text:
Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
Description: Housing scheme for urban poor providing financial assistance for construction of houses.
Category: Housing
Department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Eligibility: Annual income up to ₹6 lakh for EWS, ₹6-12 lakh for LIG, ₹12-18 lakh for MIG
Benefits: Interest subsidy on home loans up to ₹2.67 lakh
Application Process: Apply through PMAY portal with required documents
Required Documents: Aadhaar card, Income certificate, Bank account details
State: All States
Age Limit: 18-60 years
Income Limit: 1800000

metadata.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
metadata.keywords: financial, pradhan, mantri, jan, dhan, yojana, pmjdy, inclusion, program, ensure
metadata.text:
Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
Description: Financial inclusion program to ensure access to financial services for all households.
Category: Financial Inclusion
Department: Ministry of Finance
Eligibility: Any Indian citizen above 10 years of age
Benefits: Zero balance bank account, RuPay debit card, overdraft facility
Application Process: Visit any bank branch with KYC documents
Required Documents: Aadhaar card, PAN card, Address proof
State: All States
Age Limit: 10+ years

metadata.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
metadata.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
metadata.keywords: kisan, income, support, small, marginal, farmers, pradhan, mantri, samman, nidhi
metadata.text:
Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
Description: Income support scheme for small and marginal farmers.
Category: Agriculture
Department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Eligibility: Small and marginal farmers owning cultivable land up to 2 hectares
Benefits: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments
Application Process: Register through Common Service Centers or online portal
Required Documents: Land ownership documents, Aadhaar card, Bank account details
State: All States
Age Limit: 18+ years

metadata.name: Ayushman Bharat Yojana (PM-JAY)
metadata.department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
metadata.keywords: health, insurance, coverage, per, families, ayushman, bharat, yojana, jay, world
metadata.text:
Scheme Name: Ayushman Bharat Yojana (PM-JAY)
Description: World's largest health insurance scheme providing coverage for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
Category: Healthcare
Department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Eligibility: Families identified as deprived rural families and selected occupational categories of urban workers
Benefits: Health insurance coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year
Application Process: Automatic enrollment based on SECC 2011 data or through e-card generation
Required Documents: Aadhaar card, Ration card, Mobile number
State: All States
Age Limit: All ages

metadata.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
metadata.department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
metadata.keywords: lpg, women, households, pradhan, mantri, ujjwala, yojana, pmuy, clean, cooking
metadata.text:
Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
Description: Clean cooking fuel scheme providing LPG connections to women from below poverty line households.
Category: Energy
Department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
Eligibility: Women head of family from BPL households
Benefits: Free LPG connection with financial support of ₹1,600
Application Process: Apply through nearest LPG distributor with required documents
Required Documents: Aadhaar card, BPL certificate, Bank account details
State: All States
Age Limit: 18+ years

metadata.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
metadata.department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
metadata.keywords: girl, child, sukanya, samriddhi, yojana, ssy, small, savings, welfare, education
metadata.text:
Scheme Name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
Description: Small savings scheme for girl child welfare and education.
Category: Education
Department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Eligibility: Girl child below 10 years of age
Benefits: High interest rate, tax benefits under Section 80C
Application Process: Open account at post office or authorized bank branches
Required Documents: Birth certificate, Aadhaar card, Guardian's ID proof
State: All States
Age Limit: 0-10 years

metadata.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
metadata.department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
metadata.keywords: non, business, farm, pradhan, mantri, mudra, yojana, pmmy, loan, corporate
metadata.text:
Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
Description: Business loan scheme for non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
Category: Business & Enterprise
Department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
Eligibility: Indian citizen with business plan for non-farm income generating activity
Benefits: Loans up to ₹10 lakh under Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories
Application Process: Apply through MUDRA affiliated banks or NBFCs
Required Documents: Business proof, Identity proof, Address proof
State: All States
Age Limit: 18-65 years

metadata.name: National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA)
metadata.keywords: employment, rural, days, wage, financial, year, national, guarantee, act, nrega
metadata.text:
Scheme Name: National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA)
Description: Social security measure guaranteeing 100 days of wage employment in a financial year.
Category: Employment
Department: Ministry of Rural Development
Eligibility: Adult members of any rural household
Benefits: 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per financial year
Application Process: Register at Gram Panchayat with job card application
Required Documents: Aadhaar card, Address proof, Bank account details
State: Rural Areas
Age Limit: 18+ years

metadata.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
metadata.department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
metadata.keywords: pregnant, women, lactating, mothers, pradhan, mantri, matru, vandana, yojana, pmmvy
metadata.text:
Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
Description: Maternity benefit program for pregnant women and lactating mothers.
Category: Women & Child Development
Department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for first two live births
Benefits: Cash incentive of ₹5,000 in three installments
Application Process: Register at Anganwadi center or online portal
Required Documents: Aadhaar card, Bank account details, Pregnancy proof
State: All States
Age Limit: 19+ years

metadata.name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
metadata.keywords: students, national, scholarship, portal, nsp, single, platform, various, scholarships, financial
metadata.text:
Scheme Name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Description: Single platform for students to apply for various government scholarships.
Category: Education
Department: Ministry of Education
Eligibility: Students from Class 1 to PhD level based on specific scheme criteria
Benefits: Financial assistance for education expenses
Application Process: Register and apply online through National Scholarship Portal
Required Documents: Aadhaar card, Educational certificates, Income certificate
State: All States
Age Limit: Varies by scheme
